domain: Every finite genuine Boolean f:{0,1}^n->{-1,1}, every interior product bias vector p, and every physical reveal block A

definitions.M_A: H(S_A | S_B) for S drawn from the squared product-biased Fourier spectrum
definitions.J_A: I(Z;S_B), where Z is the physical assignment on A and S_B is sampled from the restricted child's squared spectrum

known_upper_baseline: B09-BIASED-BLOCK-UNCERTAINTY@1 proves the same statement with coefficient 1
known_lower_boundary: B18-AND-BIASED-TAX-LOWER-BOUND@1 proves every universal coefficient kappa must satisfy kappa>=1/2
intended_implication: If true and globally paid without reuse, this halves the local rare-bias uncertainty tax; it is not by itself an FEI theorem
